content:
incident-bot: Paging @oncall: High token usage alert for tenant Novara Health (tenant_id: novara-42) on dedicated pool nova-dedicated-1. Token rate 11x baseline, billing spike alert, incoming quota throttles. Trigger: token_count > 10M in 10m.

sara: seeing it, joining. quick snapshot: dashboard shows sustained token/sec from a handful of hosts in nova-dedicated-1. requests look normal size but tokenized length huge.

jay: can you grab a sample payload + tokenizer output? suspect encoding mismatch on their preprocessor.

sara: posted sample in thread below (redacted).
sample request body (redacted):
```json
{"prompt":"<customer data>...lots of unicode-ish chars...\n"}
```
and our tokenizer output for that prompt: 875 tokens. expected ~120.

mike: ugh. that's consistent with a UTF-16 double-byte input being interpreted as UTF-8 -> more tokens. We saw similar with a partner integration last year.

sara: initial mitigation idea: 1) apply per-tenant rate cap to slow cost growth 2) enable tokenizer override for the tenant to force byte-level BPE compatible with their preprocessor 3) open comms to Novara. Doing 1 & 2 can be fast.

elainE-cs: @sara pls hold—I'll start customer outreach. Need to explain briefly and avoid technical blame.

ops-bot: Action taken: tenant_rate_limit(applied) novara-42 limit=5 rps for 30m by sara.

sara: rate limit applied. token/sec dropped ~80% but queued requests increasing. Proceeding to apply tokenizer override now.

jay: command to apply override (internal):
```bash
redwood tenant update novara-42 --tokenizer_override=byte_bpe
```

sara: applied tokenizer_override=byte_bpe for novara-42. Verified token counts for sampled requests now ~115. Latency unchanged.

mike: good. next: we should check billing ledger to mark these spikes as suspected-encoding anomalies so ops billing team can evaluate credits. @billing can you flag novara-42 for investigation?

billing: flagged novara-42. Please collect sample timestamps and affected request IDs. Finance will start provisional credit review.

elaine-cs: messaging draft for Novara (short):
"Hi team — we detected an anomalous tokenization behavior affecting your requests that caused higher-than-expected usage. We've applied a temporary fix and rate limits to protect your service and costs. Our engineers are investigating root cause. We'll follow up with a post-incident summary and any billing adjustments"

elaine-cs: send after mike confirms root-cause and mitigations are in place.

mike: quick notes for post-incident: probable cause = customer-side preprocessor emitting UCS-2/UTF-16 surrogate pairs where our ingest path assumed UTF-8 leading to tokenization expansion. Short-term fix = tenant tokenizer override + rate cap. Long-term fix options: - add auto-detect preprocessor to convert to UTF-8 on ingress - add per-tenant tokenizer heuristic when token inflation detected - richer telemetry for encoding mismatches

sara: collecting request ids and logs and will upload to incident artifacts. I started an ephemeral runbook:
```text
1) Rate-limit tenant
2) Apply tokenizer_override
3) Notify billing & CS
4) Monitor token/sec ->< 2x baseline
5) Prepare config patch for ingress normalization
```

mike: FYI I'm taking the primary on-call for the next shift. Handoff: Sara did rate-limit + override and has uploaded samples to /incidents/1799502468/artifacts. Please watch for regressions and coordinate billing & CS.

sara: handing off. I'll be reachable via DM for 30m.

incident-bot: oncall-handoff: previous=sara new=mike at 1799502768

mike: re-checking metrics — token/sec steady at ~1.1x baseline. No more billing spikes since override. I will create an internal ticket for an ingress normalization guard and link this incident.

elaine-cs: Novara replied: "Thanks — confirmed traffic looks normal from our side, appreciate quick response. We will audit our preprocessor. Can you send list of affected request ids and times?" I shared artifacts link.

mike: next steps owners: engineering (mike/jay) -> postmortem + ingress fix timeline; cs (elaine) -> customer comms and follow-ups; billing -> credit review. Tagging oncall SRE for follow-up in 24h.

billing: starting provisional credit calc; will propose adjustments after we get final token deltas.

mike: closing incident thread for active paging. Will open incident-PR and postmortem doc. If anything new, re-ping this thread. :white_check_mark:
